summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded a US-listed universe for direct and second-order exposure to grid equipment shortages, high-voltage transmission hardware, grid power-quality systems, and renewable/data-center integration. The reference lane is represented by Hubbell as a diversified utility T&D leader. The underfollowed lane surfaces Preformed Line Products, American Superconductor, and Powell Industries as smaller or more niche public companies with plausible exposure to grid buildout, power-quality, utility qualification, and schedule-critical electrical infrastructure. No buy/sell view is implied. Expanded the US-listed universe for the high-voltage / HVDC-adjacent grid equipment node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane is represented by Hubbell as a broad, well-followed utility equipment anchor. Underfollowed lane emphasizes PLPC, AMSC, and POWL: PLPC for transmission-line hardware installed on high-voltage lines, AMSC for STATCOM / D-VAR power-quality systems used in renewables interconnection and grid voltage support, and POWL for custom-engineered power distribution, e-houses, switchgear, substations, utility, renewables, and data-center electrical infrastructure. None of these is a pure US-listed HVDC reactor supplier based on current evidence; the closest direct power-quality exposure is AMSC, while PLPC and POWL are second-order grid buildout beneficiaries.
